ar.title: سلطة الثومية

steps.n1: تخفق المستردة مع البيض إما بضرب الصفار وحده والبياض وحده وإما بضرب البيض كاملا.
steps.n2: يضاف الثوم المفري مع الزيت ويخفقوا جيدا، ثم يضاف إلى خليط البيض والمستردة ويتبل بالملح مع الخفق الجيد حتى ينعم الخليط ويصير كالكراميل.

en.title: Garlic Salad

steps.n1: Whisk the mustard with the eggs, either by beating the yolks and whites separately or by beating the whole eggs together.
steps.n2: Add the minced garlic and oil and whisk them well, then add to the egg and mustard mixture and season with salt, whisking thoroughly until the mixture is smooth and reaches a caramel-like consistency.

legacySteps: Whisk the mustard with the eggs, either by beating the yolks and whites separately or by beating the whole eggs together.

Add the minced garlic and oil and whisk them well, then add to the egg and mustard mixture and season with salt, whisking thoroughly until the mixture is smooth and reaches a caramel-like consistency.
